firstPlayerRule: Choose whoever can trace their family history back the farthest, or select the first player at random.
clarifications: The selected player receives the first player marker; it moves one player left at the start of later game turns, but not the first turn.
The original board game is distinct from Civilization: A New Dawn.

internalEvidence: The Fantasy Flight Games publisher PDF identifies Sid Meier's Civilization: The Board Game, not the later A New Dawn game. Rendered PDF page 10 states two official options: the farthest family-history trace or random selection. Rendered page 12 says the first player marker passes left on later turns, except the first.
